title: Portrait and Cipher
author: Petra Dravenmoor
blurb: Zephyrine Ishikawa, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
